name: HannStar Board Corporation
summary: HannStar Board Corporation manufactures, assembles, and sells printed circuit boards (PCBs) in Taiwan. The company provides double-sided, multi-layer, thick copper, high-density interconnect, and SLC multi-layer PCB products. Its products are used in games, televisions, liquid crystal displays, personal computers, networking and automotive products, set up boxes, servers, and other applications.
